powershell.exe -Command "@'
import subprocess, pathlib, json, os
nu=pathlib.Path('REFERENCE_BINARY.txt').read_text().strip()
cases=['1 + 2','3 * (4 + 5)','\"hello\" | str upcase','\"Hi There\" | str downcase','[1 2 3] | math sum','[1 2 3] | each {|x| "'$x * 2 }'"','{a: 1 b: \"x\"} | to json','[[a b]; [1 2] [3 4]]','[[a b]; [1 2] [3 4]] | to csv','[1 2 3] | length','if 2 > 1 { \"yes\" } else { \"no\" }','1 / 0','open definitely-missing-file','"'$env.PWD'"']
for c in cases:
 p=subprocess.run([nu,'-n','-c',c],capture_output=True,timeout=8)
 print('===',c); print('code',p.returncode); print('out',repr(p.stdout.decode(errors='replace'))); print('err',repr(p.stderr.decode(errors='replace')))
'@ | python -"
